dedupe_keys.name: monitor space hazards service of the uk national space operations centre nspoc

description: Monitor Space Hazards is the beta GOV.UK service of the Civil Warning and Protection Services of the UK National Space Operations Centre, run by the UK Space Agency. Eligible users can track conjunction events, track re-entry events, view and download satellite history and explore key statistics for UK space hazards, and the service has an API with swagger documentation, guidance on managing ephemeris, pages defining conjunction, re-entry and fragmentation event analysis information, performance monitoring and a roadmap. The GOV.UK announcement describes the UK uncontrolled re-entry early warning system, which monitors about 30 re-entry events a month that might affect the UK and Overseas Territories, the in-space collision avoidance service Monitor Your Satellites for UK-licensed satellites, fragmentation warning and monitoring, space weather alerts from the Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre, and satellite location data supplied to the Civil Aviation Authority for licensing. Licence: not stated for the data (access limited to UK licensed satellite operators and government); site content under OGL v3.0. Price and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Caveats: the service is in beta and most data is not public. Coverage is the United Kingdom and its satellites, within global orbital tracking. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis for satellites that serve telecoms, navigation and Earth observation; related records are the Met Office space weather forecast and the ESA Space Weather Service Network.
